record.viewport: 1512 CSS px wide desktop, dark mode
record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, the only difference is spacing: the three Inbox rows are 2 px closer together than in the reference, so "To review" and the bottom of the Inbox panel sit a few pixels higher.

findings.reference_location: Inbox panel, the three Needs you rows; in the 1:1 left crop the titles are at y 129, 187 and 245, with "To review 17" at y 309 (full image y 349, 407, 465, 529)
findings.reference_shows: rows 58 px apart, title to title ("Context bar: another way to show context use?", "Terminal output from herdr in the-bridge (slice 3c)", "Review the Storybook after the fidelity loop"); the Queue rows in the reference are 56 px apart
findings.render_location: same rows; in the 1:1 left crop the titles are at y 127, 183 and 239, with "To review 17" at y 301 (full image y 347, 403, 459, 521)
findings.render_shows: rows 56 px apart, 2 px less per row, so "To review 17" sits about 6 px higher relative to the first row and the panel ends higher (bottom edge about y 549 against the reference's 557)

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels. The Overview tab shows the Inbox and Queue panels (R5, R6) and no Context drift or Chats panel: those are NCC-131's (Context drift) and NCC-130's next PR (Chats, with its pager; LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: Only Inbox and Queue show. Below them the page is empty background, with no Context drift, Run check, Chats, filter chips, table or pager.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Queue. "In progress" lists the open PRs with their pills, and no priority mark or owner chat on a row ("the-bridge#535" without "· bridge-workbench"): both come from Linear, which is out of scope. There is no "Up next" group, so the Queue counts its open PRs: 3 where the frame says 8, and "In progress" 3 where the frame says 4 over three rows.
accepted_deviations.note: Queue 3 and In progress 3. The rows have no bar marks and no owner chat, so the row text starts at the mark's old position. The pills match. There is no Up next row, which leaves empty space at the bottom of the panel.

accepted_deviations.as_given: To review. The group shows as the frame draws it, closed with 17. On the live page it is empty until backend-coord decides how a chat's Inbox item names its project.
Panel headings. "Inbox" and "Queue" are PageHeader at its pane size (15 px, the count in mono), where the frame has an 18/24 heading and a 13 px count: no text style is 18 px (LIBRARY_GAPS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The headings are smaller and the panels start about 2 px higher, which follows from the smaller heading.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs. The tab row shows Overview and Ideas, where the frame shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA: only the tabs of shipped increments show (d-133), and Ideas is increment one's.
accepted_deviations.note: Overview is selected and Ideas has a lightbulb icon.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the frame draws it; no frame draws its composer, so it is the library Dialog on every size, and in a state it opens nothing.
accepted_deviations.note: The button matches the reference, 4 px further left because of the sides deviation (A10).

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the frame has the owner's name: the secret scan's personal-term rule keeps the name out of web/. The live page shows the brain's own words.
accepted_deviations.note: The purpose reads "The owner's personal workspace for thinking, ..." on one line.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top. The back row with Quick chat, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than the frame's: the page starts 24 down, as the home does, where the frame has 28, which no spacing token has. The tabs are where the frame draws them, so the gap above them is 4 px larger.
accepted_deviations.note: Projects is at y 39 against 43 and the title at y 92 against 96. The tabs are at y 186 in both.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rail. The rail is the app's shared one in the default order (d-105, d-119): Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts, Toolkit and More. The frame draws an older rail with Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More. The page never changes the shared rail (pages/projects/AGENTS.md).
accepted_deviations.note: The rail shows Artifacts and Toolkit before More. Projects is selected.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Sides. The page has 40 px sides, as the home has, where the frame has 36, so the header and the tabs are 4 px right of the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The header, the tabs and the Inbox panel start at x 104 against 100. Quick chat and the Queue panel's right edge end at x 1472 against 1476. The gap between the panels is the same, so each panel is about 4 px narrower.

limits: Only static renders were given, so I could not check hover, focus or the Quick chat dialog.
The full images were viewed at their native 1512 px width; the coordinates above were read from them and from the 1:1 crops and are accurate to about 1 px.
